changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpreauthorizationcareteam AS SELECT pact.id, pact.pre_authorization_id, pact.sequence, pact.practitioner_name, pact.physician_code, pact.practitioner_role, pact.care_team_role, pact.speciality, pact.speciality_code, pact.qualification_code, pact.created_date, pact.created_by, pact.last_modified_by, pact.last_modified_date FROM public.pre_authorization_care_team pact;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationcareteam TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationcareteam FROM report_user;
